parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
  to: $vars.DOCTOR_PHONE,
  type: 'text',
  text: {
    body:
      '🔔 New Booking Request\n\n' +
      '👤 Patient: ' + $json.patient_name + '\n' +
      '📱 Phone: ' + $json.phone + '\n' +
      '🪪 ID: ' + ($json.id_number || 'Not provided') + '\n' +
      '📅 Date: ' + $json.date + ' at ' + $json.time + '\n' +
      '💳 Payment: ' + ($json.payment_method === 'medical_aid'
        ? ($json.medical_aid || '') + ($json.medical_plan ? ' (' + $json.medical_plan + ')' : '') + ' #' + ($json.membership_number || 'N/A')
        : 'Cash') + '\n' +
      '💬 Reason: ' + ($json.reason_for_visit || 'Not specified') + '\n' +
      '📌 Source: ' + ($json.source || 'WhatsApp') + '\n\n' +
      '✅ Open your dashboard to approve or reject.'
  }
}) }}
